### Pipeline 5: Final Story Finishing (RIFE Frame Interpolation + MMAudio Foley)
**Purpose:** Polishes your assembled lossless story cut into a broadcast-ready delivery MP4.

- **Why Run RIFE Only at Final Export?** During Pause-and-Pivot editing, every frame index (`0 .. N`) must represent a real Wan 2.2 frame (`24 fps`). Interpolating earlier would create synthetic blended tween frames. Running **RIFE 4.26 (Node `2`)** *only* at the end doubles motion smoothness (`24 -> 48 fps`) cleanly.
- **Video-Synced Foley (Nodes `3`–`4`):** **MMAudio Large 44.1kHz v2** watches the actual video frames to synthesize synchronized footsteps, cloth movement, door clicks, and room ambience guided by your foley prompt.

_meta.title: 📖 READ FIRST — Pipeline 5: Post-Export Finishing (RIFE + MMAudio)
_meta.description: Explains why frame interpolation and foley audio synthesis happen only after all shots and branches are locked.

_meta.title: [1] Load Assembled 24 fps Lossless Story Master
_meta.description: Loads the concatenated FFV1 lossless master assembled from your chosen shot branches.

_meta.title: [2] RIFE 4.26 Optical-Flow Interpolation (24 -> 48 fps)
_meta.description: Doubles frame rate to 48 fps (multiplier=2) with VRAM cache clearing every 16 frames so long sequences never OOM.

_meta.title: [3] Load MMAudio Large 44.1kHz v2 Foley Engine
_meta.description: Multimodal video-to-audio model generating full-bandwidth 44.1 kHz sound effects.

inputs.prompt: subtle room tone, realistic footsteps and cloth rustle

_meta.title: [4] Synthesize Frame-Synced Foley & Ambience
_meta.description: Describe environmental sounds and physical impacts (e.g., 'rain on window, leather jacket rustle, wooden floorboards').

_meta.title: [5] Encode Final Delivery Master (H.264 MP4, CRF 17, 48 fps + Audio)
_meta.description: High-bitrate CRF 17 H.264 MP4 downloaded back to ~/ComfyFactory/outputs/<project>/exports/.
